subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.**

My uncle __is doing__ business in Hyderabad for the last 10 years.
solution:
The correct answer is "**has been doing**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence should be in the **present perfect Continuous tense.**
 
• We need to use "**has been**" in the given sentence to make it the **present perfect continuous tense.**
 
• "**Has**" is an auxiliary verb used with the third person present tense and "**been**" is the past participle of "be".
 
• We use "**has been**" to describe actions that started in the past but continue to the present time.

**The correct sentence is:** *My uncle **has been doing**__** **business in Hyderabad for the last 10 years.*

Hence, the correct answer is** option 1.**
